_comment: Hand-labeled eval set for CivicPulse AI. 'categorization' tests zero-shot category accuracy (incl. Hindi/Hinglish). 'duplicate_groups' tests dedup: texts in the same group are the SAME real-world problem (should merge); texts in different groups are different problems (should NOT merge).
